question: Select the misspelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"exhilerated"** is misspelt. The correct spelling is **"exhilarated"**, which means feeling very happy, animated, or elated. (उत्साहित)

 
 
• **Example: **She felt exhilarated after completing the marathon.
 
 
 
• **"Facetious" **means treating serious issues with deliberately inappropriate humor; flippant. (हास्यपूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example: **His facetious remarks during the meeting were not appreciated.
 
 
 
• **"Officious" **means assertive of authority in an annoyingly domineering way, especially with regard to petty or trivial matters. (अधिकार जताने वाला)
 
 
• **Example: **The officious security guard wouldn't let us enter the building without checking our IDs twice.
 
 
 
• **"Conspicuous" **means standing out so as to be clearly visible; attracting notice or attention. (विशिष्ट)
 
 
• **Example: **Her bright red dress made her conspicuous in the crowd.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Facetious **(हास्यपूर्ण): Treating serious issues with deliberately inappropriate humor; flippant.

 
 
• **Example:** His facetious remarks during the meeting were not appreciated.
 
 
 
• **Officious **(अधिकार जताने वाला): Assertive of authority in an annoyingly domineering way, especially with regard to petty or trivial matters.
 
 
• **Example: **The officious security guard wouldn't let us enter the building without checking our IDs twice.
 
 
 
• **Conspicuous** (विशिष्ट): Standing out so as to be clearly visible; attracting notice or attention.
 
 
• **Example:** Her bright red dress made her conspicuous in the crowd.
